prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent game CHARACTER ATTACK sprite sheet, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 full-body drawings, each inside an equally sized cell with clear transparent gutters. No grid lines.
Image 1 is the exact character identity and painted anime style reference ONLY. Make a NEW combat sheet, not another walking sheet.
Character: same small orange tabby cat adventurer, big amber eyes, cream muzzle, red scarf, cream shirt, brown vest and satchel, olive trousers, brown boots. A short steel sword with a brass crossguard is physically HELD in its RIGHT PAW. The sword must be integrated into the drawing, not floating, both arms anatomically correct, gripping the hilt. Preserve identical head size, face, body size, clothing and sword across all sixteen drawings.
ROWS are four directions, all columns in a row keep that camera view: row 1 faces front three-quarter southeast/lower right; row 2 front three-quarter southwest/lower left; row 3 rear three-quarter northeast/upper right; row 4 rear three-quarter northwest/upper left. No human, no dog.
COLUMNS are sequential stages of ONE powerful sword strike: column 1 anticipatory wind-up, feet planted, sword raised back, shoulders visibly turning; column 2 active slash, arm extended forward with short sword following a clear diagonal arc; column 3 follow-through, weight shifted onto forward boot, sword lower in front, scarf trailing; column 4 return to a ready stance, sword still held, feet relaxed planted. Show real torso, shoulders, elbow and paw movement, not just rotating a sword in front of a static body. Keep hips and foot baseline near the same place inside each cell, with equal scale and enough margin to fit ears, tail, sword and all boots.
Art: polished hand-painted anime JRPG sprites, clean readable anatomy, soft cel shading, restrained line work, matches the charming original cat, no pixel art, consistent soft upper-left lighting.
Transparent background; no environment, no shadows, no colored background, no text, no labels, no motion blur, no swoosh VFX, no duplicate weapons, no extra hands. Full silhouettes remain inside their own cell. All cells equal size and figure scale.
